name: get_recent_transactions
description: Log in, open the Account Activity page for account {{account_id}}, and read the first 5 transactions listed into an output named recent_transactions

approved_plan.goal: Log in, open the Account Activity page for account {{account_id}}, and read the first 5 transactions listed into an output named recent_transactions

steps.intent: Log in with the supplied credentials and reach the Accounts Overview page
steps.action: Replay fragment parabank_login@1.0.0 using the supplied username and password

steps.intent: Navigate to the Account Activity page for the specified account
steps.action: Locate and click the link corresponding to account_id on the Accounts Overview page to open its Account Activity page

steps.intent: Read the first 5 transactions listed in the Account Activity table
steps.action: Extract the first 5 rows from the transaction table on the Account Activity page, capturing each transaction's details (e.g. date, description, debit/credit, amount) into the recent_transactions output

parameters.name: username
parameters.description: The username used to log in to ParaBank

parameters.name: password
parameters.description: The password used to log in to ParaBank

parameters.name: account_id
parameters.description: The account number whose Activity page will be opened

approved_plan.success_signal: The Account Activity page is displayed, showing a transaction history table with a heading such as "Account Activity" or "Transaction Results" for the specified account, and at least one transaction row is visible in the table

review_notes: s04_extract: only one locator candidate (text) — no fallback if it stops matching

inputs.name: account_id
inputs.description: The account number whose Activity page will be opened

inputs.name: username
inputs.description: The username used to log in to ParaBank

inputs.name: password
inputs.description: The password used to log in to ParaBank

outputs.name: recent_transactions
outputs.description: Read from the page during discovery; returned as text

business_outcomes.description: The requested account_id does not appear in the Accounts Overview table — the account does not exist or does not belong to the authenticated user.
The username/password combination was rejected by ParaBank and login did not succeed.
The Account Activity page loaded successfully but the transaction table contains no rows — the account has no transaction history to return.

when.value: The username and password could not be verified.

then.message: ParaBank rejected the supplied credentials. Verify that username and password inputs are correct.

when.value: An internal error has occurred and has been logged.

then.message: ParaBank reported an internal server error during login. The application may be unavailable.

candidates.rationale: accessible role and name, most stable across restyling

then.message: No link matching account_id '{{account_id}}' was found in the Accounts Overview table. The account does not exist or is not accessible to this user.

on_exhausted.message: No link for account_id '{{account_id}}' exists in the Accounts Overview table. The account is absent or inaccessible for the authenticated user.

candidates.rationale: accessible role and name, most stable across restyling
